questions.stem: Three angles in a quadrilateral are $90°$, $80°$, and $110°$. What is the fourth angle?
questions.explanation: Angles in a quadrilateral sum to $360°$: $360° - 90° - 80° - 110° = 80°$.

questions.stem: The angles of a quadrilateral are $x$, $2x$, $3x$, and $4x$. What is the value of $x$?
A trapezium has two co-interior angles between parallel sides. One is $115°$. What is the other?
questions.explanation: Co-interior angles between parallel sides sum to $180°$: $180° - 115° = 65°$.

questions.stem: A parallelogram has one angle of $72°$. What is the angle adjacent to it?
questions.explanation: Adjacent angles in a parallelogram are supplementary: $180° - 72° = 108°$.

questions.stem: A kite has angles of $100°$, $100°$, and $70°$. What is the fourth angle?
questions.explanation: Angles in a quadrilateral sum to $360°$: $360° - 100° - 100° - 70° = 90°$.

questions.stem: Opposite angles in a parallelogram are:
questions.explanation: In a parallelogram, opposite angles are always equal. It is the adjacent angles that are supplementary.
